subject: Make valkey compatible with redis-sentinel to start sentinel (#731)
reason: The change only adds a second strstr on argv[0]'s basename so that a redis-sentinel symlink starts Sentinel mode. The trigger is the name the binary is invoked under, which nothing in the fuzzer controls: the runner supplies the build and launches it as valkey-server, valkey.action.tools runs only the four whitelisted tools, valkey.action.commands starts its private servers under the real binary name, and Sentinel is not a supported deployment mode, so no experiment composed from installed components can reach the changed branch.
